title: cloud/factory vitest emits a wall of workerd hung-context exceptions
description:
Surfaced by xrz. cloud/factory pnpm exec vitest run reports 13/13 files and 252/252 green while emitting a wall of uncaught workerd exceptions (io-context.c++:1593 ... code had hung). Pre-existing — the tick author reports their own new file produces none.

Why it is worth a tick rather than tolerating: the noise is more than enough to hide a real failure in a CI log, and this suite is the factorys only automated guard. A green run nobody reads carefully is a guard in name only.

Find which suite leaves a request unresolved. 79x already recorded the likely shape: a test that ignites a run and never ends it keeps the Workflow supervising, and the next test file in the shared workerd runtime inherits the mess — that report recommends ending every run a test starts (process.exit(0); await settled(runID)).
acceptance_criteria: cloud/factory vitest runs clean with no uncaught workerd exceptions; the suite that left a request unresolved is named and fixed; the tests still pass.
